challenges.name: Gold Rush
challenges.rule: Break open at least 2 of the 3 chests. A chest that falls off is lost.

challenges.name: Pirate Hoard
challenges.rule: Open the chests before the sea takes them.

challenges.name: Beat the Clock
challenges.rule: 40 seconds. Heroes keep coming, fire fast.

challenges.name: Forge Sprint
challenges.rule: Hit the lever to drop the crusher, then clear the forge in 50 seconds.

challenges.name: One Perfect Shot
challenges.rule: One Boomer. Start the chain reaction in the right barrel.

challenges.name: Hold the Line
challenges.rule: Three waves drop in. Keep your soldiers standing.

challenges.name: Sky Raiders
challenges.rule: Two airships sail at you. Defeat each crew before it docks.

challenges.name: Harbor Assault
challenges.rule: Sink the galleon and the raft before they reach your shore.

specials.name: Flooded Foundry
specials.rule: Iron protects the low guards. Open the sluice, then clear the high keep.

specials.name: Mill of Teeth
specials.rule: Break the mill brake. The wheel must batter the iron room loose.

specials.name: The Last Rope
specials.rule: Cut one suspension rope to tip three guards into the canyon.

specials.name: Faultline Vault
specials.rule: Break the keystone. The iron vault and everyone in it must fall.

specials.name: Counterweight Hall
specials.rule: Hit the lever to run the pulley and lower the counterweighted span.

specials.name: Powder Express II
specials.rule: Cut the brake rope. The powder cart is your only bomb.

specials.name: The Siege Pitcher
specials.rule: Slam the beam to throw its keg into the high iron vault.

specials.name: Clockwork Deluge
specials.rule: One lever starts the wheel and opens the sluice. Time the chain reaction.

specials.name: Bridge at World's End
specials.rule: Collapse the rope bridge, then break the cliff beneath the last vault.

specials.name: Master's Chain
specials.rule: Release the powder cart, topple the dominoes, and fire the throwing beam.
